DiscoveryIndex.target.cfg.ref: Index-contract review A2: evidence armed before the first read, own writes tapped before they are issued and when they settle, reads installed under the directory's evidence counter. 2 directories, 2 changes, 1 own write, 1 repeated fact, no lost fact.

DiscoveryIndex.target-lost.cfg.ref: A2 and A4: one fact lost and the audit on. CleanIsCurrent holds outside the lost directory, and EventuallyCurrent under LiveSpec (weak fairness of arming, delivery, the reads, the audit and the own write's completion). Quiescence: Quiescent. 2 directories, 1 change, 1 lost change, 1 own write, 1 repeated fact.

DiscoveryIndex.clear-unconditional.cfg.ref: Index-contract review F5, A2(f): a read that clears its directory unconditionally loses the fact that arrived while it ran. 1 change.

DiscoveryIndex.read-before-arm.cfg.ref: Index-contract review F4, A2(e), A3: the first read runs before the observer, the notice subscription or the poll baseline is in place, so a change between them is in no fact. 1 change.

DiscoveryIndex.tap-after-write.cfg.ref: Index-contract review F2, A2(a): own writes heard only when they settle, as the change bus reports them, leave the directory clean while its bytes have changed. 1 own write.

DiscoveryIndex.no-audit.cfg.ref: Index-contract review F3, A4: a lost fact with no audit is never repaired; the audit is load-bearing. 1 lost change, audit off.
